name: Review AppStruct service requests and email an exception summary

nodes.name: Map and audit every supplied row

parameters.jsCode:
function serviceRequestCsvRows(audit) {
  // A report, not a source-data round trip. Raw values remain in the audit node.
  function cell(value) {
    if (typeof value !== 'string') return value
    return /^[\s\uFEFF]*[=+@-]/.test(value) || /^[\t\r\n]/.test(value) ? `'${value}` : value
  }
  const common = {
    row_type: 'summary',
    reference_date: audit.referenceDate,
    source_row: '',
    id: '',
    request: '',
    status: '',
    owner: '',
    due_date: '',
    overdue: '',
    needs_review: '',
    flags: '',
    recommendation: '',
    total_rows: audit.summary.totalRows,
    clean_rows: audit.summary.cleanRows,
    review_rows: audit.summary.reviewRows,
    overdue_rows: audit.summary.overdueRows,
    unassigned_rows: audit.summary.unassignedRows,
    duplicate_id_rows: audit.summary.duplicateIdRows,
    duplicate_ids: audit.summary.duplicateIds,
  }
  return [
    common,
    ...audit.records.map((row) => ({
      ...common,
      row_type: 'request',
      source_row: row.sourceRow,
      id: cell(row.id),
      request: cell(row.request),
      status: cell(row.status),
      owner: cell(row.owner),
      due_date: cell(row.dueDate),
      overdue: row.overdue,
      needs_review: row.needsReview,
      flags: row.flags.join('; '),
      recommendation: row.recommendation,
      total_rows: '',
      clean_rows: '',
      review_rows: '',
      overdue_rows: '',
      unassigned_rows: '',
      duplicate_id_rows: '',
      duplicate_ids: '',
    })),
  ]
}
return serviceRequestCsvRows($input.first().json).map(json => ({ json }));

parameters.content:
## Review an AppStruct request queue
Read a table, map its columns, check IDs, status, owners and calendar due dates, download a CSV, and optionally email a counts-only exception summary. No source records are changed.

### Setup
1. Install the verified AppStruct node (n8n-nodes-appstruct 2.0.1). On self-hosted n8n use 2.47.7+ and Node.js 24+. Select your AppStruct and SMTP credentials in their nodes; no credentials or account IDs are included. If email is unnecessary, remove the If and Email branch.
2. In Configure review, set projectId, tableName and the five exact returned field names. Status values must be new, in_progress or done. Use an authorized practice table first.
3. Set timezone (default UTC). An empty referenceDateOverride uses the execution date in that zone. Due dates must be YYYY-MM-DD, not timestamps.
4. Run manually with notify=false. Inspect the audit and CSV, including the source-row count.
5. To receive exception summaries, set your authorized fromEmail/toEmail and notify=true. Email sends counts only, no names, text or CSV. It sends nothing for a clean or empty queue.

[Setup, sample data and expected results](https://blog.appstruct.ai/blog/n8n-service-request-queue-audit?utm_source=n8n_template&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=queue_audit_20261120&utm_content=live_digest_overview#connect-an-appstruct-table-and-prepare-an-exception-summary)

## Read before reporting
Use a small table (fewer than 2000 records by default). AppStruct Get Many fetches the table and applies Limit locally; it does not paginate the source. A result reaching Limit stops the review so a truncated queue is not reported as complete. Empty output is supported via Always Output Data. Errors stop execution; they are not treated as an empty queue. Compare with your source count. Missing mapped request/status columns stop the review. Duplicate IDs stay separate.

## CSV and optional notification
CSV contains a summary plus every supplied row, with formula-like text prefixed by an apostrophe. The email branch sends counts only when notify=true and reviewRows>0. SMTP is user-configured.

After a successful manual read and an authorized test email, set the workflow timezone to match Configure review, enable the weekday 09:00 schedule, save and publish. The download is inactive and its schedule is disabled. Repeated runs may send the same summary; delivery is not exactly-once. Review execution retention for private data. No customer messages or source updates are performed.
